targeting.source: GOB 66 targets a selected enemy, has a 16 m selection range and uses viral contest TestFunction 2.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler validates the live selection. AbilityTargets and FreeCastViralContest evaluate sight and deflection before applying the debuff.
targeting.test: PR443 stock passed empty and clear selection. PR456 stock retained the selection across a mapped gap and logged blocked sight without target effects (PacketLog 8cb156ff9409). FreeCastViralLandingTests.ActualNpcLandingDeflectsBeforeDamageDebuffAndProcAndOnlyRoutesToVisibleSameWorld runs 66 against the actual deflection gate. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/443 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/456
